Hi Sophie,

Thanks — happy to clarify. Below are concrete answers and a suggested quickstart path for the hosted eval.

1) Endpoints & data residency
- Hosted API endpoints: us.redwoodinference.com (US), eu.redwoodinference.com (EU). For the hosted eval we can provision a US-only tenant; data (logs/metrics) for that tenant stays in-region by default.
- If you require on-prem or VPC-only access, that is available under Private (longer lead time).

2) Rate limits & burst handling (hosted)
- Default eval tier: 60 requests/minute with soft burst up to 300 requests/minute for short periods; token limits are 120k tokens/minute per API key for eval.
- For sustained high-throughput we recommend Dedicated where we can reserve GPU pools and set predictable QPS.
- We also support per-route rate limits and circuit-breaker fallbacks to a cheaper model variant to preserve availability.

3) Trial inclusions & support
- Typical hosted evaluation: 30 days, $5k credit applied to usage, and 2 scheduled support hours with an SE. No SLA during trial; production SLAs available with committed plans.

4) Security & retention
- Retention controls: we can set logs to 0/7/30/90 day retention per tenant. PII deletion requests are supported; we also offer a Private deployment for customers needing no data egress.

Quickstart curl (US endpoint):

curl https://us.redwoodinference.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-prod-7b","input":"Summarize the following..."}'

Suggested next steps:
- Start hosted eval with 3 API keys (ingestion service + 2 developer keys). We'll enable a higher soft-burst for your ingestion window.
- I'll prepare a short SOW draft (attached) outlining the eval credits and deliverables.

Attachments: proposal-finexa-draft.docx

Let me know if you want me to join a technical sync with your infra team.

Best,
